Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned for the POC/trial: 

Recap: 
- Primary goal: Evaluate Redwood inference for low-latency conversational search in Hyperion’s product catalog (90% of queries within 300ms p50).
- Success criteria we discussed:
  - Latency: p50 < 300ms, p95 < 700ms under simulated traffic (TBD qps)
  - Relevance: > 85% precision on curated evaluation set
  - Cost: cost per 1k tokens under $X (we’ll quantify based on your baseline)
- Stakeholders: Alicia (Product), Tom (Infra), Marissa (Sales/Engage), Logan (Solutions), Neha (Customer Success)

Proposed POC scope & timeline (high level):
1) Kickoff & environment setup (Week 0): share access, confirm data subset and metrics (owner: Hyperion / Redwood)
2) Baseline run & evaluation (Week 1): Redwood runs initial model against provided eval set; capture latency/cost
3) Optimization & tuning (Week 2-3): batching, quantization to meet SLOs; weekly check-ins
4) Final readout (Week 4): results, recommended config and next steps

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Hyperion: share sample evaluation set (CSV/JSON) and expected QPS window by Fri 7/10 — Alicia
- Redwood: send POC success criteria doc + evaluation template by EOD Tue 7/07 — Marissa (attached)
- Redwood Solutions: prepare staging env details and support plan — Logan (ETA 7/09)
- CS: propose weekly check-in cadence (30 min) — Neha

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria.docx (template), MVP_eval_plan.xlsx (evaluation matrix)

Does this look right to you? If so, can we lock the kickoff for Monday 7/13 at 10am PT?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
